card.name: Spots just before a drug-label detail
card.fires_on: Points in drug-label text where a specific next piece is expected: the number after an opening parenthesis in a section reference, 'of' after 'use' or 'dosage', and the start of 'ocular' or 'timolol'.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The space or digit right after an open parenthesis, before a label section number like 5.3 or 2.3.
modes.example: severe hepatic impairment ( <<2>>.3 ) Renal impairment: should

modes.label: 'of' before a drug name
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'use' or 'dosage', just before the drug name.
modes.example: The effective dosage<< of>> rivastigmine transdermal system

modes.label: Start of eye or drug words
modes.description: The first piece of a longer word such as ocular or timolol.
modes.example: in patients who develop<< oc>>ular symptoms or use TRELEGY E
